notes.title: Small update to 1.19
notes.notes:
-Fixes soft lock at the Dark Antenna with the destroyed blocks
-Fixed conveyor platforms so that they disappear and reappear, so you don't have to wait an eternity for them to reappear.
-Updated Localization files. (Except there are none, lol tf2.)

notes.title: Arcanion Switch Release Update.
notes.notes:
v.1.10 updated to v.1.16

Changes:
Japanese Language added. プレイしていただきありがとうございます。このやりがいのあるゲームを楽しんでいただければ幸いです。

-Adjusted some backgrounds to make it less stressful on the eyes.
-Added additional sounds to Magi's attacks, and other parts of the game.

Casual Mode:
-Potions do not lose use upon death and return to the amount you had before you cross a checkpoint. 
-Some stages have been adjusted to help differentiate classic and casual.


Bug Fixes:
-Fixed major soft lock bugs with the Tamrin and Kraken Boss Fight
-Fixed item shop description bugs.
-Fixed Save System issues.
-Fixed Aura Barrier stacking issue.
-Fixed issue with Aura Ring where you could jump and not fire three shots.
-Fixed soft-lock bug on Floating Island where you died at a hidden room and the game just stops.
-Fixed some grammatical and spelling errors.

notes.title: Arcanion way overdue patch notes, like, seriously overdue.
notes.notes:
v.1.00 updated to v.1.10

Changes:
-Casual Mode has been added where some of the more difficult maps have been adjusted to make the run less stressful. Classic Mode will retain the original difficulty as before the patch.
-A new hidden room was added in the Floating Island level, can you be able to find it?
-The final boss' defense has increased, making it a little tougher to defeat.
-The Tamrin boss fight has been tweaked between the Casual and Classic run.
-Arcanion Abbey's stage was altered minimally to reduce difficulty.

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed bug where the music would stop in some stages after starting from a checkpoint after you died.
-Fixed bug where there was no bottomless pit in one of the sections of the final stage.
-Fixed bug where Wicca would disappear during the Arcanion Abbey stage segment.
-Fixed bug where Magi in the cart could ram into a wall before jumping.
